description: This Java class defines a Spring configuration component that registers a global filter for an API gateway. The filter extracts the user's principal from the security context, retrieves the username if applicable, and adds it as a custom header ('X-Auth-Id') to outgoing requests passing through the gateway.

classes.name: GatewayConfiguration
classes.description: Spring configuration class that provides a custom global filter bean for API request processing.

methods.name: customGlobalFilter
methods.description: Defines a global filter that retrieves the username from the security principal and injects it into the request header as 'X-Auth-Id'.
